{{Quote|There's a large-scale civil war on Balith. They've requested our assistance. Anakin, you will leave immediately to command the Third Legion.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to Anakin Skywalker|audio=CivilWarOnBalith-TCW-Assassin.flac|<ref name="Assassin" />}}
The '''Third Legion''' was a [[Legion/Legends|military unit]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Assassin" /> a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that took place from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|307}}</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding information for [[Balith system/Legends|Balith system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Balith/Legends|Balith]] was in the middle of large-scale [[Balith civil war|civil war]] prompting its people to request aid from the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] responded by dispatching [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Balith to [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] the Third Legion and aid the people of Balith. Skywalker along with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] immediately boarded a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] to travel to Balith from<ref name="Assassin" /> he [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Assassin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Third Legion was first mentioned in "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]],"<ref name="Assassin" /> the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series which aired on [[October 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode307.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin}}</ref>
